high_level_description: stc brand style, an aerial view of a geodesic dome event venue in a desert canyon, with rows of tables and a man on a horse in the foreground.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A vast sandy desert canyon with rocky cliff walls, a large white geodesic dome tent, and rows of white tables leading up to it.

elements.desc: A large white geodesic dome structure with a glass entrance, surrounded by white tents and a truck.
A man standing beside a white horse with a blue saddle, positioned on a rocky outcrop overlooking the venue.
Rows of white tables and chairs arranged along a path leading to the dome.
